description: This file declares the Gem5Manager class, a subclass of VmManager, responsible for managing guest VMs using the gem5 simulation environment. It includes method declarations for configuration, starting VM commands, and checking support, along with related includes and namespace organization.

classes.name: Gem5Manager
classes.description: A class to manage gem5-based VMs, providing configuration and startup functionalities.

methods.name: std::string name()
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the VM manager type, 'gem5'.

methods.name: Gem5Manager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Gem5Manager with a specified architecture.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports gem5 for VM management.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for the VM based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot devices for the VM based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the command sequence to start the VM and manages dependencies.
